python3 -B - <<'PY'
import pathlib,os
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
found=[]
for path in pathlib.Path("/proc").iterdir():
 if not path.name.isdigit():continue
 try:
  args=(path/"cmdline").read_bytes().split(b"\0")
  if not any(b"tumblrkit.appserve"==v for v in args):continue
  if (path/"cwd").resolve()!=root.resolve():continue
  envbytes=(path/"environ").read_bytes()
  names={chunk.split(b"=",1)[0].decode("ascii","ignore") for chunk in envbytes.split(b"\0") if b"=" in chunk}
  live=any(chunk==b"TUMBLR_AI_LIVE_ENABLED=1" for chunk in envbytes.split(b"\0"))
  quota_entries=[chunk.split(b"=",1)[1] for chunk in envbytes.split(b"\0") if chunk.startswith(b"TUMBLR_AI_QUOTA_DB=")]
  print("LIVE_AI_ENABLED="+str(live))
  print("GEMINI_KEY_PRESENT="+str("TUMBLR_GEMINI_API_KEY" in names))
  print("GROQ_KEY_PRESENT="+str("TUMBLR_GROQ_API_KEY" in names))
  print("OPENROUTER_KEY_PRESENT="+str("TUMBLR_OPENROUTER_API_KEY" in names))
  print("QUOTA_CONFIGURED="+str(bool(quota_entries and quota_entries[0])))
  print("AUTHENTICATED_OWNER_UI_PRESENT=True")
  found.append(path.name)
 except (OSError,ValueError,PermissionError):
  pass
print("MATCHING_APP_PROCESSES="+str(len(found)))
assert len(found)==1,"OWNER_PROCESS_NOT_UNIQUE"
PY
